engine.layout: 1.6 L (1597 cc) inline four, DOHC, 16 valves, belt-driven cams
engine.output: 116 hp at 6500 rpm, 100 lb-ft at 5500 rpm
engine.fuel_system: Multiport fuel injection, vane-type airflow meter (AFM), speed-density is NOT used
engine.ignition: Distributorless wasted-spark: one coil pack firing 1&4 and 2&3, crank position read by the cam angle sensor (CAS) on the back of the exhaust cam
engine.valve_lash: Hydraulic lash adjusters (no adjustment). Ticking at startup is common and often clears as oil pressure builds.
engine.diagnostics: Pre-OBD-II. No OBD-II port; codes are read as flashes of the check engine light using the diagnosis connector (see trouble codes).

tune_up.value: 10 degrees BTDC at idle, set with the TEN terminal of the diagnosis connector grounded
800 to 900 rpm, warm, accessories off, TEN grounded
Standard about 182 psi, minimum about 128 psi, max spread between cylinders about 28 psi (at cranking speed, warm, throttle open)
60,000 miles. Replace the water pump, tensioner and cam/crank seals at the same time. The 1990 1.6 is generally considered non-interference, but do not rely on that.

fluids.capacity: about 3.6 US qt (3.4 L) with filter

fluids.spec: DOT 3 or DOT 4 (shared reservoir type: do not mix with DOT 5 silicone)
